Based on the Lease Abstract for Northgate Business Park, the anchor tenant, Vantage Fulfillment Co. (which leases 62% of the net rentable area), holds **two successive five-year renewal options**. Each option:

- Is exercisable at **95% of then-prevailing fair market rent**
- Requires **twelve months' prior written notice** before exercise
- Is conditioned on the **tenant not being in monetary default** at the time of exercise
